title: Shaping the Evolutionary Dynamics of Robot Morphology via Adaptive Control Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.23100v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot co-design via bi-level optimization couples within-lifetime controller learning for fitness evaluation with cross-generational morphological evolution. Prior work has established that well-adapted morphology facilitates faster control learning, a property termed morphological intelligence. Yet how control learning reciprocally shapes morphological evolution remains unexplored. This paper examines both directions for a holistic account of brain-body interplay. We first show that morphological contributions to control learning decouple into two orthogonal dimensions. We formalize the convergence speed as morphological intelligence and identify the performance ceiling as a complementary quantity termed true potential. A concise functional relation is then established to jointly characterize both quantities from individual learning curves, which, when aggregated at the population level, capture evolutionary profiles. translated_title: 通过自适应控制学习塑造机器人形态的进化动力学
translated_abstract: 机器人协同设计通过双层优化，将个体生命周期内的控制器学习（用于适应度评估）与跨代的形态进化相结合。先前的研究已表明，适应良好的形态能促进控制器的更快学习，这一特性被称为形态智能。然而，控制学习如何反向影响形态进化仍未被探索。本文考察了这两个方向，以全面理解大脑-身体相互作用。我们首先展示了形态对控制学习的贡献可解耦为两个正交维度。我们将收敛速度形式化为形态智能，并将性能上限识别为一个补充量，称为真实潜力。随后，建立了一个简洁的函数关系，从个体学习曲线中联合表征这两个量，在群体水平上聚合时，能够捕捉进化特征。通过广泛的实验验证，我们揭示了这些动态。
tldr: 本文首次揭示了控制学习对形态进化的反向塑造作用，通过将形态贡献解耦为形态智能和真实潜力两个正交维度，并建立函数关系从学习曲线中联合表征，从而全面理解大脑-身体协同进化动力学。
en_tdlr: This paper first reveals how control learning reciprocally shapes morphological evolution, decoupling morphological contributions into two orthogonal dimensions—morphological intelligence and true potential—and establishing a functional relation to jointly characterize them from learning curves, providing a holistic account of brain-body co-evolution dynamics.
